svg.text: An actual index-ten affine inclusion and its Laurent observable
G = F2[t,t^-1] + semidirect Z; s0 = 1, s1(x) = x+1, s2(x) = tx; |t| = 1/2
Stable expected Jones triple [AH.4–AH.6]
phi_+ phi_-(P) subset phi_+(P) subset P
+ sqrt(1/5)22><same|
E_+(p_+) = 1/10; full cup corner and spanning.
Common finite compression [AH.7–AH.9]
N = h1 L1 h1 subset M = h1 P h1
II1 factors; [M:N] = 10; cup trace = 1/10
Coherent finite stages retain every marked cup.
Full finite relative commutants and both inherited traces [AH.10–AH.11]
Endpoint blocks: E_IJ occurs exactly when g(I) = g(J) in the actual group G.
Even words, length 2m: tau(q_I) = 2^n(g)/10^m; rho(q_I) = 2^-n(g)/10^m
First branch weights: (1/4,1/4,1/2); dual weights: (2/5,2/5,1/5); kC = (8/5,8/5,2/5)
Every smooth representation and the actual normal observable [AH.12–AH.20]
Actual right Folner sets give F: represented V -> M, UCP, F|M = id, E_N F = F E.
Pair height drift = 3/10 > 0; X = limit b_k lies in K = F2((t)).
Start plus law = mu_V; start minus law = mu_U. Distinct x, x+1, tx recover p0,p1,p2.
Full normal center isomorphisms, with separate laws [AH.18, AB.31]
j_U: L-infinity(K,mu_U) -> Z(S) j_V: L-infinity(K,mu_V) -> Z(R)
Full joint center: Z(S) join Z(R) = direct sum_i p_i Z(S).
Every compatible physical central state has joint discrepancy 3/5 and reciprocal cost 6. [AO.3]
All maps and constants are exact; layout is schematic and encodes no metric lengths or trace areas.
